blocks.text: OAS, ALBAY, Philippines — The municipal government of Oas launched its digitalization program Tuesday (Nov. 17), offering online services aimed at reducing bureaucratic processes and helping residents save time and money by eliminating the need for in-person transactions at municipal offices.
